editorial.blurb: Song Lynn is a humble Vietnamese spot that consistently delivers authentic, flavorful pho and dishes that keep locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the pho during off-peak hours if you want to linger—this place moves fast during busy times, and portions are generous enough that regular size is plenty.
signatureDishes: Spicy Song Lynn Special Beef Sate Pho

topDishes.note: Rich, clean broth with massive, tender tendon—Houston-level good

topDishes.note: Very flavorful with a nice kick
